pages.text: Candles provide stability to rituals and are an important part of almost all pentacles.$(br)$(bold)Large Candles also act like bookshelves for enchantment purposes.$()$(br2)Candles from Minecraft and other Mods may be used in place of $()
Key ingredient for large candles. Kill large animals like pigs, cows or sheep with a $(item)Butcher Knife$()$(br)to harvest $(item)Tallow$().$(br)
You can use a dye and the $(item)Large Candle$() to mix then in shapeless craft process to get a colored large candle.$(br2)Available in all the 16 minecraft dyes.$(br)

Just like the candles from Minecraft, $(item)Large Candle$() and colored versions can be lit, turning in a great light source.$(br2)In addition, you can use a $(item)torch$(), $(item)soul torch$(), $(item)copper torch$(), $(item)redstone torch$() or $(item)spirit torch$() to change the $()
type of fire.$(br2)Also can be waterlogged.$(br)
